name: App builder — iteration
description: The follow-up loop to “App builder — idea to launch”: keep developing the app after the initial cycle. A change request (feature, fix, or feedback) becomes iteration requirements (the PM persona reads the launch cycle's quality report for context if it exists) → the CTO reads the current code and plans the minimal change set → YOUR sign-off → implementation with tests (✎ write tier) → full suite with a fix-and-retest loop → an independent code review → an iteration report that ends by proposing the next three iterations. Run it manually per request — or make it fire itself: add a chat-keyword trigger (e.g. “iterate on the app”), or a chain trigger after another workflow.

input.label: What to build or fix next
input.placeholder: e.g. add weekly streak stats to the dashboard · fix the login redirect loop

nodes.text:
If dev/app-report.md or dev/iteration-report.md exist in the workspace, read them for context (read_file) — they describe the app and its known weaknesses. Then turn this change request into iteration requirements: what changes, what must NOT change (regressions to guard), and 2-5 testable acceptance criteria.

Request: {{input}}

Write the iteration report as Markdown: the request ({{input}}), what changed and why ({{node.3}}), final test status ({{node.6}}), review findings ({{node.9}}) — and finish by proposing the three most valuable NEXT iterations.
